name: SIQ - Horizon Split
description: Cinematic split-screen editorial gallery with alternating image-text layouts. Each entry features a full-bleed image on one side and rich editorial content on the other, with numbered entries, decorative accent lines, scroll-triggered slide-in animations, and optional parallax. Choose from 3 layout styles: alternating, all-left, or all-right. Full control over spacing, aspect ratios, typography, colors, and hover effects. Perfect for case studies, project portfolios, brand stories, and editorial presentations. 80+ customization options.
author: SectionIQ
